item.title: How to Progress Fast in Call of Duty: All About Levels, Ranks, and Accounts
item.description: A lot of CoD players run into the same thing sooner or later - your progress just kinda slows down. At the start it’s all fun: new maps, new guns to mess with, a bunch of challenges popping up. Then out of nowhere the XP feels way slower, and everyone else is running around with fully - upgraded setups and perks you don’t even have yet. item.title: FBI - Lone Wolf & Wolf Pack - Review : Never Hurt One Of Their Own
item.description: What an absolute whirlwind of emotions I experienced throughout that two-hour ordeal. So many things happened that I am honestly trying to remember what happened at the start of that first episode. In all honesty I did love that we got a two-hour dosage of FBI, however I do feel that it does need to be watched as two separate episodes.
